package unit

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestPracticeReadinessMigrationPersistsImmutableScopedReceipts(t *testing.T) {
	up, err := os.ReadFile("../../db/migrations/016_practice_learning_readiness_receipt.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	down, err := os.ReadFile("../../db/migrations/016_practice_learning_readiness_receipt.down.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, fragment := range []string{
		"UNIQUE (task_instance_id, step_id, idempotency_key)",
		"request_hash",
		"receipt_json",
		"practice-learning-readiness-receipt.v1",
		"BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(up), fragment) {
			t.Errorf("readiness migration is missing %q", fragment)
		}
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(down), "cannot remove practice_learning_readiness_receipt while readiness evidence exists") {
		t.Fatal("down migration must refuse to discard persisted readiness evidence")
	}
}
